accounts.error.active_missing: The active account is no longer available. Select or connect a workspace account to continue.
accounts.error.go_key_missing: The active account has no OpenCode Go key. Add one in Settings to use its models.
accounts.error.home_other_app: Another Terminus app with this same data — or the previous version's Seldon Plan Host, if you just updated — is working with this agent. Wait for it to finish or close it, then send again.
accounts.error.vault_unreadable: I couldn't open the key your connections are stored with, so I couldn't check this account. Nothing was lost: try again and accept the permission your computer asks for.
accounts.error.profile_unreadable: Could not verify the email for this account. Check your connection and try again.
accounts.error.profile_in_use: Could not verify the identity. Try again when the task using this account finishes.
accounts.error.profile_reconnect: Claude rejected this account connection. Reconnect it.
accounts.secret.opencode_database: The session stays in this account's folder, in OpenCode's database, unencrypted.
